newsitem.title: ITALY: MOST ITALIANS SATISFIED WITH BANKING SERVICES - ABI.
newsitem.headline: MOST ITALIANS SATISFIED WITH BANKING SERVICES - ABI.

text.p: Italian bank customers are increasingly satisfied with services on offer and are using them more and more, the Italian Banking Association (ABI) said.
An ABI report said 67 percent of private customers said they were very or fairly satisfied with their bank in a 1996 poll against 64 percent in a similar survey carried out in 1994.
The survey showed that 85 percent of bank clients had a current account, against 80 percent in 1994, and 49 percent had a cashpoint card versus 40 percent in 1994. -- Rome newsroom +392 66129689
